This '''city''' was located on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].

==History==
The city was located in a forested valley. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dooku's palace/Legends|palace]] was situated on a cliff overlooking the city.
